audience: makers and IoT developers who send sensor data to Adafruit IO feeds and dashboards

useCases.title: Get the latest reading of a feed
useCases.text: The AI reads the most recent data point of a feed with its value, location and time. You can ask for a sensor value without opening the dashboard.

useCases.title: Look at a feed's readings and trend over time
useCases.text: The AI reads data points of a feed in a time range, or aggregated chart data with avg, min, max or sum per resolution. You can spot trends in temperature or humidity.

useCases.title: List your feeds and when each last got data
useCases.text: The AI lists all feeds with key, unit, last value and last update, and the groups of feeds. You can find feeds that went quiet.

useCases.title: Explore dashboards and their widgets
useCases.text: The AI lists dashboards and the blocks on one, such as gauges, toggles and charts, with the feeds they use.

useCases.title: Publish a data point or create a feed
useCases.text: The AI publishes one value to a feed, or creates a new feed, optionally in a group. A published value can drive devices subscribed to the feed.
